svg.title: Custom Membership in OpenRaft
svg.desc: Five abstract membership shapes surround a shared pair of intersecting quorum rings: equal-sized nodes for threshold membership, different-sized nodes for weighted membership, a tree of sites for hierarchical membership, a grid, and freely overlapping sets for explicit membership. Blue marks read quorums and green marks write quorums. The title and subtitle sit on black space above a full-color flower photograph at the bottom right. A faint cluster of membership shapes and its quorum key occupy the open space on the left.
svg.text: Read and write quorums, defined by your application.
